stems: median player matched stem against stem: the seated chamber probe (Op. 3.1 recipe, chamber size, 4 bars), model against still recordings

pizzicato.method: each instrument's recorded pizzicati (vsco2-ce, iowa-mis: each pitch's loudest layer, its named string where the bank names one); the model's notes plucked at 0.08, 0.12, 0.17, 0.25 of the string from the bridge, the position whose attack's brightness (centroid of twelve harmonics over 40 ms) is nearest the recordings' (median); then each string's losses (0.25, 0.35, 0.5, 0.7, 1, 1.4, 2, 2.8, 4, 5.6, 8 times its modes' own) whose decay at 0.3 and 1 s after the peak is nearest (median of the sum of the two differences); the pull at the loudest recorded dynamic setting the pluck's peak over the model's bowed level as far as the recorded peak is over the recorded bowed level (median), the other dynamics' pulls in proportion to the model's bowed levels, never less than a softer one's

pressureMeasured.method: at mf, four notes an instrument: overpressure the least force-over-speed among forces x1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16 and speeds x1, 0.7, 0.5 whose notes go out of tune (20 cents) and whose median periodicity (normalized autocorrelation at the fundamental's period, 0.6-1.6 s) is under 0.9; flautando, of forces x0.8, 0.6, 0.45, 0.35, 0.25, 0.18, 0.12, 0.08, 0.05, 0.03, 0.02, 0.012, 0.008 at speed x1.6 and contact 0.2, the last before the first whose notes leave Helmholtz motion (out of tune by 20 cents, periodicity under 0.9, or the fundamental's share under half the ordinario's: a surface sound)

ladder.method: each dynamic ppp to fff as the compiler plays it (a note from silence, its attack and release at the dynamic's speed), thirteen notes an instrument (each open string among them), each also in 4 strokes of 0.15 s each changing bow, its last 2 heard as a render's notes are, contacts 0.06, 0.085, 0.12, 0.165, 0.2 and forces 0.03, 0.045, 0.065, 0.09, 0.13, 0.18, 0.25, 0.35, 0.5, 0.7, 1, 1.4, 2, 2.8, 4, 5.6 N (times its force scale): the speaking bow (judged on the string's force on the bridge where the driver writes it, its level and onset on its sound: periodicity 0.9 within 90 ms of its bow and after, in tune within 20 c, fundamental or octave 25 dB over the spectrum round it, as render/sounding.mjs hears a render's notes) nearest its rung of a 3 dB ladder down from the loudest fff that speaks, each string its own force, the instrument's gain its mezzo-forte's against its recordings'; beyond, force multiples nearest a ladder of steps each 0.65 the last (an instrument's ladder says of how many notes: nine, before its open strings and quick strokes were heard)

variants.method: each of the model's 3 variants of an instrument, its instrument's contacts and levels by dynamic kept, each string two forces of 0.03, 0.045, 0.065, 0.09, 0.13, 0.18, 0.25, 0.35, 0.5, 0.7, 1, 1.4, 2, 2.8, 4, 5.6 N (times its force scale), within 1.5 octaves of its instrument's own: low, under which its notes 0, 1, 4 semitones over its open pitch speak as the ladder hears them, nearest its instrument's level at that dynamic, near the louder dynamic's (1.5 dB an octave of force), from forte up a note unspoken weighed as 4 dB; high, no lighter, the same for its notes 7 and 12 over it (and five under its compass's top on its highest string); on the driver patched to accelerate its bow either way
